'''Kameyama Hachimangū''' (亀山八幡宮, ''Kameyama Hachimangū'') is a [[Shinto]] shrine located in {{ill|Shimonoseki|ar|شيمونوسيكي (ياماغوتشي)|arz|شيمونوسيكى، ياماجوتشى|az|Şimonoseki|azb|شیمونوسکی، یاماقوچی|ban|Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi|be|Сіманасэкі|bg|Шимоносеки|ca|Shimonoseki|ce|Симоносеки|ceb|Shimonoseki (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Šimonoseki|de|Shimonoseki|eo|Ŝimonoseko|es|Shimonoseki|et|Shimonoseki|eu|Shimonoseki|fa|شیمونوسکی، یاماگوچی|fi|Shimonoseki|fr|Shimonoseki|ga|Shimonoseki|gl|Shimonoseki|hak|Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi|hy|Սիմոնոսեկի (քաղաք)|id|Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi|it|Shimonoseki|ja|下関市|ko|시모노세키시|mg|Shimonoseki|ms|Shimonoseki|mzn|شیمونوسکی، یاماگوچی|nl|Shimonoseki|no|Shimonoseki|pl|Shimonoseki|pt|Shimonoseki|ro|Shimonoseki|ru|Симоносеки|sc|Shimonoseki|sco|Shimonoseki|sh|Shimonoseki|simple|Shimonoseki|sq|Shimonoseki|sr|Шимоносеки|sv|Shimonoseki|szl|Shimonoseki|tg|Шимоносеки|th|ชิโมโนเซกิ|tl|Shimonoseki|tr|Şimonoseki|tt|Симоносеки|tum|Shimonoseki|uk|Сімоносекі|ur|شیمونوسیکی، یاماگوچی|vi|Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi|war|Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi|wuu|下关市|zh|下关市|zh_classical|下關市|zh_min_nan|Simonoseki-chhī|zh_yue|下關市|qid=Q203308|lt=Shimonoseki}}, {{ill|Yamaguchi Prefecture|en|Yamaguchi Prefecture|qid=Q127264|lt=Yamaguchi Prefecture}}, Japan. It is a [[Hachiman shrine|Hachiman Shrine]], dedicated to the [[kami]] [[Hachiman]]. The [[kami]] enshrined there include {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|en|Emperor Ōjin|qid=Q317997|lt=Emperor Ōjin}}, {{ill|Empress Jingū|en|Empress Jingū|qid=Q232803|lt=Empress Jingū}}, and {{ill|Emperor Chūai|ar|الإمبراطور تشواي|arz|الامبراطور تشواى|azb|چوای (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Chūai|cs|Čúai|de|Chūai|es|Chūai Tennō|fa|امپراتور چوآی|fr|Chūai|hr|Chūai|hu|Csúai japán császár|id|Kaisar Chūai|it|Chūai|ja|仲哀天皇|ka|ტიუაი|ko|주아이 천황|nl|Chuai|pl|Chūai|pt|Chuai|ru|Император Тюай|sh|Car Chūai|simple|Emperor Chūai|sl|Cesar Čuaj|sv|Chuai|th|จักรพรรดิชูไอ|tl|Emperador Chūai|tr|Chūai (imparator)|uk|Імператор Тюай|uz|Imperator Chūai|vi|Thiên hoàng Chūai|zh|仲哀天皇|zh_min_nan|Tyûai Thian-hông|zh_yue|仲哀天皇|qid=Q179971|lt=Emperor Chūai}}. It was established in 859, and has an annual festival on October 15.
The shrine can be reached by bus from {{ill|Shimonoseki Station|arz|محطة شيمونوسيكى|fr|Gare de Shimonoseki|it|Stazione di Shimonoseki|ja|下関駅|ko|시모노세키역|pl|Shimonoseki (stacja kolejowa)|zh|下關站|qid=Q1130253|lt=Shimonoseki Station}}.
